events.summary: First Day of School — Staggered Start
events.description:
MCS Day 1 is staggered across two days.

Thu Aug 13: grades K–6 with last names A–L, plus grades 7, 9 and 12.
Fri Aug 14: grades K–6 with last names M–Z, plus grades 8, 10 and 11.

All students attend on Mon Aug 17.

mecc.summary: First Day of School — Staggered Start (MECC)
mecc.description:
MCS Day 1 at MECC is staggered by last name.

Thu Aug 13: last names A–L.
Fri Aug 14: last names M–Z.

All students attend on Mon Aug 17.

mhs.summary: First Day of School — Staggered Start (MHS)
mhs.description:
MCS Day 1 at Mason High School is staggered by grade.

Thu Aug 13: grades 9 and 12.
Fri Aug 14: grades 10 and 11.

All students attend on Mon Aug 17.
